links.outcome: Readability (Flesch Reading Ease, Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level) of LLM answers versus professional resources
links.effect: Professional resources outperformed the LLMs on readability. LLM responses often need simplification to meet recommended health-literacy standards. Quality, understandability, actionability and empathy did not differ.
links.quote: However, readability remains a key limitation, as LLM-generated responses often require simplification to align with recommended health-literacy standards.

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM performance (readability, DISCERN, PEMAT, ECCS) against professional cancer resources for answering post-treatment quality-of-life questions without testing a specific organizational guardrail or deployment practice.
